ingredients: Fresh berries (such as strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) for topping
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg, then add the milk and melted butter. Mix well.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. It's okay if the batter is a bit lumpy.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Lightly grease with butter or cooking spray.
Pour a scoop of pancake batter onto the skillet to form a round pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook the other side until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adjusting the heat if needed to prevent burning.
Serve the fluffy pancakes hot, topped with fresh berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.
Enjoy your delicious and easy homemade breakfast!
